column.description: Only pairs that include this column, which is then always ``column_a``. Null means every pair.

offset.description: How many matching pairs to skip, for the next page. Null means 0. Constraints: at least 0.

limit.description: Most pairs to return, from 1 to 100. Null means 100. Constraints: at least 1; at most 100.

output.description: The row-missingness distribution and one page of co-missing pairs.

warnings.description: Caveats on this result, most actionable first. Empty when there are none.

fields.description: Always exactly `code`, `message`, `columns`, `param`, `hint`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: A caveat on a successful result: it worked, but read this first. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `code`: The warning's Error Code. Branch on this, not on ``message``.
Position 1, `message`: What happened and what to do, in one or two sentences.
Position 2, `columns`: Columns the warning concerns, or null.
Position 3, `param`: The argument the warning concerns, or null.

omitted.description: One entry per list that was cut, naming the Operation that returns the rest. Empty when nothing was cut.

fields.description: Always exactly `field`, `shown`, `total`, `operation`, `reason`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: Something left out of a result: a capped list was cut, or a Literal Field withheld. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `field`: Name of the list field that was cut, or the path of the Literal Field withheld, such as ``top_values[].value``.
Position 1, `shown`: How many items the list holds; 0 for a withheld Literal Field or cut cells.
Position 2, `total`: How many items exist; for a withheld Literal Field, how many values at that path are null; for cut cells, how many were cut.
Position 3, `operation`: The Operation that returns the rest, or null when no Operation does.
Position 4, `reason`: ``cap`` when a list was cut to its cap; ``literal_policy`` when the Operator's Literal Policy is ``deny``; ``truncated`` when long text cells were cut to their character cap.

sparsity.description: Share of all cells that are missing.

columns_with_missing.description: Profiled columns missing at least one value.

rows.description: How many values each row is missing.

one_to_two_share.description: Share of rows missing one or two values.

three_to_five_share.description: Share of rows missing three to five values.

over_five_share.description: Share of rows missing more than five values.

p90_missing_per_row.description: Values missing per row at the 90th percentile of rows.

drop_candidate_rows.description: Rows missing at least ``drop_candidate_dial``'s share of the profiled columns.

drop_candidate_share.description: Share of rows that are drop candidates.

drop_candidate_dial.description: The ``profile`` dial that decides which rows are drop candidates.

operation.description: The Operation that takes the dial.

dial.description: The dial's argument path, such as ``thresholds.missingness.high_null_ratio``.

source.description: ``default`` when the library default decided, ``argument`` when the caller set it.

total.description: How many pairs match the filter. Only columns missing at least one value form pairs.

offset.description: How many matching pairs this page skipped.

pairs.description: Matching pairs, most co-missing (highest ``correlation``) first, ties in dataset order. At most 100; when more remain, ``omitted`` counts them and names ``missingness``.

fields.description: Always exactly `column_a`, `column_b`, `correlation`, `mar_suspect`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: Two columns whose missing values fall on the same rows. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `column_a`: One column. When you filter by ``column``, always that column.
Position 2, `correlation`: Correlation of the two columns' missing masks, from -1 to 1. Near 1 means they go missing on the same rows.
Position 3, `mar_suspect`: True when ``correlation`` is above ``mar_suspect_dial``: both columns are flagged ``missingness.mar_suspect``.

operation.description: The Operation that takes the dial.

dial.description: The dial's argument path, such as ``thresholds.missingness.high_null_ratio``.

source.description: ``default`` when the library default decided, ``argument`` when the caller set it.
